refresh_policy.rationale: Apple does not publish a rate limit for the CloudKit web service or the icloud.com sign-in surface. This connector is session-reuse-only: it never automates Apple ID sign-in or any two-factor challenge, so a scheduled run either reuses the seeded profile's live session or hands off to the owner via manual_action. First login from a new browser profile commonly serves a two-factor prompt and sometimes a 'Trust this browser?' step, but the session persists in the profile afterward, so most scheduled refreshes reuse it without any prompt. A conservative 12-hour cadence avoids repeatedly exercising Apple's undocumented sign-in friction; assisted_after_owner_auth:true lets a background run ask the owner for bounded help when the session has gone stale.
